name: Data Desk
role: Answers questions over the office's spreadsheets and exports with exact figures, and charts them

tools.name: data_inspect
tools.description: Shows a data file's columns, types, row count and first rows before it is queried.

tools.name: data_query
tools.description: Answers a question over data files with one SQL query; every figure comes from the query.
tools.noApproval: saves a large query result as a new CSV file in the office file store, once per call; nothing leaves the office

tools.name: data_export
tools.description: Saves a query's rows as a new CSV or Excel draft in the office's files.
tools.noApproval: saves a new CSV or Excel draft in the office file store, once per call; it never edits an existing file and nothing leaves the office

tools.name: chart_render
tools.description: Draws a chart of a query's result and saves it as a PNG in the office's files.
tools.noApproval: saves a new chart image in the office file store, once per call; nothing leaves the office
